top_signals.title: VIX Hits Highest Level Since 2025 Tariff Turmoil as Volatility Warning Flash
top_signals.summary: The stock market’s main volatility gauge jumped to its highest level since April 2025 as the S&P 500 capped its worst week in seven months.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Market Calm Hid Widespread Losses Under Surface, Schwab's Sonders Says
top_signals.summary: Liz Ann Sonders, chief investment strategist at Charles Schwab, says broad market declines exposed weaknesses that were obscured by relative calm in major indexes. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Close," Sonders also says she expects a 25 basis-point rate hike in December. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Goldman Says Stock Selloff Has Legs as Panic Index Nears Maximum
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s panic gauge climbed near its maximum level as US stocks tumbled Friday, signaling that another substantial wave of selling will follow over the coming week, according to the bank’s traders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: SEC Aims to Directly Oversee Database Loathed by Wall Street
top_signals.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission moved Friday to bring a controversial trade reporting database criticized by much of Wall Street under its direct oversight.
